import HartshorneLib.Chapter4DifferentialDivisor
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4DivisorModule
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4DivisorDevissage
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4DivisorMultiplication

/-!
# The canonical divisor and its local divisor-module bound

For a nonzero rational differential, the unit rational function is a local
section of the associated divisor module exactly on the locus where the
differential is regular.  This is the local bridge from the canonical divisor
to the sheaf `O(K)`; it uses only the intrinsic differential lattice and does
not choose a local frame.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] [IsProper X.hom]

/-- On a nonempty open, the unit rational function satisfies the local bounds
of the differential divisor exactly at the points where the differential is
regular.  This is the pointwise canonical-divisor/sheaf bridge. -/
theorem one_mem_divisorSections_differentialDivisor_iff
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0)
    (U : X.left.Opens) (hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty) :
    (1 : X.left.functionField) ∈
        divisorSections (differentialDivisor X ω hω) U ↔
      ∀ (x : X.left) (_hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left), x ∈ U →
        ω ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x := by
  rw [mem_divisorSections_of_nonempty hU]
  constructor
  · intro h x hx hxU
    have hbound := h x hx hxU
    rw [map_one] at hbound
    rw [divisorBound_eq_coeffAt hx,
      coeffAt_differentialDivisor X ω hω hx] at hbound
    change ((↑(1 : Multiplicative ℤ) : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) ≤
      (↑(Multiplicative.ofAdd (curveDifferentialOrder X hx ω hω)) :
        WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) at hbound
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ CurveDivisor.coeffAt hx
        (differentialDivisor X ω hω) := by
      rw [coeffAt_differentialDivisor X ω hω hx]
      exact_mod_cast hbound
    exact (coeffAt_differentialDivisor_nonneg_iff X ω hω hx).mp hnonneg
  · intro h x hx hxU
    rw [map_one, divisorBound_eq_coeffAt hx,
      coeffAt_differentialDivisor X ω hω hx]
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ CurveDivisor.coeffAt hx
        (differentialDivisor X ω hω) :=
      (coeffAt_differentialDivisor_nonneg_iff X ω hω hx).mpr (h x hx hxU)
    rw [coeffAt_differentialDivisor X ω hω hx] at hnonneg
    change ((↑(1 : Multiplicative ℤ) : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) ≤
      (↑(Multiplicative.ofAdd (curveDifferentialOrder X hx ω hω)) :
        WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    exact_mod_cast hnonneg

/-! Rescaling the differential transports the regular unit section by the
inverse scalar. -/
theorem inv_mem_divisorSections_differentialDivisor_smul_iff
    (a : X.left.functionFieldˣ)
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0)
    (U : X.left.Opens) (hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty) :
    (↑a⁻¹ : X.left.functionField) ∈
        divisorSections
          (differentialDivisor X ((a : X.left.functionField) • ω)
            (smul_ne_zero (Units.ne_zero a) hω)) U ↔
      (1 : X.left.functionField) ∈ divisorSections
        (differentialDivisor X ω hω) U := by
  have hdiv : principalDivisor a + differentialDivisor X ω hω =
      differentialDivisor X ω hω - principalDivisor a⁻¹ := by
    rw [principalDivisor_inv]
    abel
  rw [differentialDivisor_smul_of_nonzero X a ω hω, hdiv]
  rw [divisorSections_of_nonempty hU, divisorSections_of_nonempty hU]
  simpa only [map_one, mul_one, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (Units.ne_zero a)] using
    (mem_boundedSections_mul_iff (X := X) (U := U) a⁻¹
      (differentialDivisor X ω hω) (1 : X.left.functionField))

/-- The pole bound of a differential divisor is the inverse valuation of the
differential's coefficient in the selected regular local frame. -/
theorem divisorBound_differentialDivisor_eq_inv_orderAt
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0)
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) :
    divisorBound (differentialDivisor X ω hω) hx =
      (orderAt X.hom hx
        (curveDifferentialCoordinate X x (curveDifferentialFrame X x) ω))⁻¹ := by
  rw [divisorBound_eq_coeffAt, coeffAt_differentialDivisor,
    curveDifferentialOrder, orderZAt]
  simp

/-- A rational function satisfies the canonical divisor bound at a point
exactly when multiplying the defining differential by it gives a regular
differential. This includes the zero rational function. -/
theorem orderAt_le_differentialDivisor_iff
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0)
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (f : X.left.functionField) :
    orderAt X.hom hx f ≤ divisorBound (differentialDivisor X ω hω) hx ↔
      f • ω ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x := by
  rw [divisorBound_differentialDivisor_eq_inv_orderAt,
    mem_curveRegularDifferentialLattice_iff X hx (curveDifferentialFrame X x),
    map_smul, smul_eq_mul, map_mul]
  have hc : 0 < orderAt X.hom hx
      (curveDifferentialCoordinate X x (curveDifferentialFrame X x) ω) := by
    apply zero_lt_iff.mpr
    apply (Valuation.ne_zero_iff _).mpr
    exact fun h => hω ((curveDifferentialCoordinate X x
      (curveDifferentialFrame X x)).map_eq_zero_iff.mp h)
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa only [inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hc)] using
      (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_right hc).mpr h
  · intro h
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_right hc).mp
    simpa only [inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hc)] using h

/-- On each nonempty open, multiplication by a nonzero rational differential
identifies the divisor bounds with regularity at every nongeneric point. -/
theorem mem_divisorSections_differentialDivisor_iff
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0)
    (U : X.left.Opens) (hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty)
    (f : X.left.functionField) :
    f ∈ divisorSections (differentialDivisor X ω hω) U ↔
      ∀ (x : X.left) (_hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left), x ∈ U →
        f • ω ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x := by
  rw [mem_divisorSections_of_nonempty hU]
  exact forall_congr' fun x => forall_congr' fun hx => forall_congr' fun _ =>
    orderAt_le_differentialDivisor_iff X ω hω hx f

end
end Hartshorne
